fields.PRODUCT NAME: Rajasthani Handcrafted Pink Floral Ceramic Tile Wall Hook
fields.DESCRIPTION: Brighten up your walls with this charming Rajasthani handcrafted wall hook. Designed with a vibrant pink ceramic tile featuring intricate floral motifs in yellow, red, and green, it beautifully reflects traditional artistry. The sturdy wrought iron frame and glossy ceramic knob make it both decorative and functional—ideal for hanging keys, bags, clothes, or accessories. A perfect blend of utility and ethnic elegance, this piece adds a colorful accent to any home décor.
